description.zh:
給定四個代表笛卡爾座標的實數：\(\left(x_{1},y_{1}\right),\left(x_{2},y_{2}\right)\)。寫一個函式 distance(x1, y1, x2, y2) 來計算點 \( \left ( x_{1}, y_{1} \right ) \) 和 \( \left ( x_{2}, y_{2} \right ) \) 之間的距離。讀取四個實數並列印函式計算出的距離結果。

兩點之間距離的公式可以在 Wolfram 中找到。

C++ 注意： 實作請求的函式並從 main 呼叫它。在遞迴練習中，不要用迴圈代替遞迴。
description.en:
Given four real numbers representing cartesian coordinates: \( \left ( x_{1}, y_{1} \right ), \left ( x_{2}, y_{2} \right ) \). Write a function distance(x1, y1, x2, y2) to compute the distance between the points \( \left ( x_{1}, y_{1} \right ) \) and \( \left ( x_{2}, y_{2} \right ) \). Read four real numbers and print the resulting distance calculated by the function.

The formula for distance between two points can be found at Wolfram.

C++ note: Implement the requested function and call it from main. In recursion exercises, do not replace recursion with a loop.

hint.zh: 請實作題目指定的函式並由 main 讀取輸入、呼叫函式及輸出結果；遞迴題不得使用迴圈取代。
hint.en: Implement the requested function and call it from main. In recursion exercises, do not replace recursion with a loop.
